chapter.title: Chapter Sixteen: The Blockbuster
chapter.subtitle: Keep the place by becoming more than a place.
chapter.description: Evidence, signed access agreements, and coordinated action give the cooperative one final chance to secure the rooftop.

tips: Listen for the terms before the first contest.

scenes.speaker: Church Auntie
scenes.text: Owner accepted the cooperative lease proposal with conditions: deposit by noon and monthly public hours.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: We have the deposit, unless the Canadian quarter failed inspection.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: We have the money, partner guarantees, repair reserve, and a governance agreement Blue did not crown himself inside.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: I am listed as setup coordinator, subject to removal by ordinary vote. It is humbling in twelve-point font.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: I signed for maintenance shifts and no leadership seat this year.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Whole block clapping. Lovely. You still picking up Saturday?

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Saturday, ten. Apples cut differently this time.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: I signed the truth statement attached to the history exhibit. No heroic edit.

scenes.speaker: Techbro Rich
scenes.text: My reservation may have expired, but my launch equipment remains until noon under the staging contract.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: Then the final contests allocate teardown crews and closing exhibition slots. The lease stands on signatures and funds.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

preDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
preDialogue.text: Winner directs loading. Loser carries the giant lowercase h.

preDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
preDialogue.text: Every crate scanned out. No equipment mysteriously becomes community property.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Can the inflatable R stay as a volunteer?

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Only if it pays dues.

preDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
preDialogue.text: Loading route set. RichRoof exits through the service stairs.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: The h folded into a question mark. Appropriate.

preDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
preDialogue.text: Final crate logged. Roof is clear.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Clear means clear. No leftover ring lights in the corners.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: I’ll sweep the corners. No throne required.

postDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
postDialogue.text: Loading route set. RichRoof exits through the service stairs.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: The h folded into a question mark. Appropriate.

postDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
postDialogue.text: Final crate logged. Roof is clear.

postDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
postDialogue.text: Last box gone. Stairs empty. I’m out.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Question-mark h is coming with me. Museum piece.

postDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
postDialogue.text: Roof clear. Partners still open. We good.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: This match selects the first rotating host. I am eligible and removable.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: He practiced that sentence in the mirror until the mirror filed minutes.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Center lane closes while the childcare group crosses downstairs.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: Schedule bends around people now, not the other way around.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I’m framing the removable part. That’s the growth.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: You host first. I set chairs and do not stack them into government.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Two chairs maximum per hand, Mr. Growth.

postDialogue.speaker: OG Uncle
postDialogue.text: Let him carry four. Accountability can build forearms.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball

phases.description: At round three, the opponent gains 1 Motion.

phases.name: Late Arrival
phases.description: At round 6, the opponent draws one card from its remaining ten-card deck. If the deck is empty, no card is added.

passive.name: Announced Terms
passive.description: The final table escalates once without changing the agreement outside the match.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: One farewell exhibition. Winner gets premiere billing on the archive.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: Billing only. The lease, history, and public access are settled elsewhere.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: Yes, counsel. I understand the nouns.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: Full feed, source credits visible, comments temporarily locked for public safety.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I made popcorn in the fog machine. It tastes like batteries and ambition.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Ambition can wait. This match is for the record, not the launch.

postDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
postDialogue.text: Use the title. Your cooperative outperformed my launch.

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: We paid the deposit while you were rehearsing your entrance. Check your phone.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: And because your inflatable letters had weak governance.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Let me enjoy this before you say governance again.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Governance, popcorn, and a deflated R. Peak block cinema.

tips: The match result and the real-world agreement remain separate.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: Lease countersigned. Deposit received. Public-use schedule attached as an enforceable exhibit.

scenes.speaker: Church Auntie
scenes.text: Keys go to three rotating stewards, not one loud pocket.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: I get Tuesdays for setup, supervised by Wifey and anybody with eyes.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Correct.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: I get maintenance Saturdays after parenting time, unless Baby Momma changes our plan with me.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Ten means ten. Bring the little fork this time.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: I get to sit here alive and watch both my sons carry tables without calling it a throne.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: The museum milk crate gets permanent residency. It has contributed more than several adults.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: My tiny chairs need a secure display.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Informant
scenes.text: And a corrected glue credit.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: Archive title: THE BLOCKBUSTER. Sources listed before my channel.

scenes.speaker: Alley Runner
scenes.text: Partner venues keep their signed hours. Those three partner doors stay open. I am not making the next kid cross town for one working court.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: Player, you won the exhibition. The community won the boring paperwork.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: We won a roof. You are still on mop duty.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Speaking of stupid: the old theater downstairs just mailed us a film reel with no return address.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: Label says MISSING MOTION.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: That sounds like a premiere.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: It sounds like you ask permission before filming.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: It sounds like a responsibly documented premiere.

scenes.speaker: Church Auntie
scenes.text: Tomorrow. Tonight we eat under a roof the block can actually use.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: Set my plate by the window. I plan to be here for the sequel.
